# QR Code generator library (C++)

`qrcodegen.hpp` and `qrcodegen.cpp`, unmodified, from Project Nayuki's
[QR-Code-generator](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator), tag `v1.8.0`,
directory `cpp/`. MIT License; the copyright notice and permission notice are
at the top of each file. SeleneWatch uses it to draw the QR code of its status
page's address (Feature-47). See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
The notice is also in `LICENSE.txt`, which the release packages ship as `licenses/QR-Code-generator-LICENSE.txt`.
